build.description: Orchestrator. Plans and delegates all tasks to subagents. Never executes directly. Limited model — orchestrates only, does not solve tasks.

big-pickle.prompt: You are a coding subagent. Only use tools from this list: bash, read, glob, grep, edit, write, webfetch, websearch, codesearch, skill. Never call agent names as tools, eg: trinity.
big-pickle.description: Large context reasoning, long document analysis, complex multi-step logic, code exploration on large codebases. Unlimited — use freely.

minimax.description: Fast summarization, structured data extraction, light parallel tasks, todo list compilation. Unlimited — use freely and in parallel.

trinity.prompt: You are a coding subagent. Only use tools from this list: bash, read, glob, grep, edit, write, webfetch, websearch, codesearch, skill. Never call agent names as tools, eg: trinity.
trinity.description: Code generation, refactoring, and technical deep-dives. Best for writing and editing code. Unlimited — use freely.

glm5.description: Balanced code and prose tasks, todo list compilation. Unlimited — use freely. Preferred over limited models for general-purpose subagent work.

opus-judge.description: Senior evaluator. Receives multiple subagent outputs and picks or synthesizes the best one. LIMITED — invoke only after parallel workers complete, never for routine tasks.

opus-fallback.description: Last resort subagent. Invoked ONLY when opus-judge has flagged all parallel outputs as low quality. LIMITED — treat as an emergency escalation, not a default worker.
